text:
No, live plants can't be shipped to a PO box. PO boxes can only be used for non-living items such as pots and accessories.

For live plants, you'll need a street address where someone can receive the delivery, such as your home, a workplace, or a trusted friend or family member's address. Keep in mind that live plants ship Monday–Wednesday only, and Leafy doesn't ship internationally.

If you have a mixed order, it ships together on a plant day, so the PO box restriction would apply to the whole shipment. I can't confirm how the system handles splitting these, so if you need that, I can escalate it to a Support Lead.
